amendment_reason: Before all executions: a one-letter 22-symbol input cannot predict an entire target containing all 24 Greek symbols. Use an ordered pair of adjacent Hebrew ranks, encoded as a base-22 integer modulo 24, allowing all 24 outputs. No empirical target fitting.
description_cost: 12 bits only conditional on fixed grammar: 1 direction + 3 offset + 3 multiplier-index + 5 intercept bits; also report full canonical rule JSON bytes, grammar bytes, decoder source bytes, source manifests, input-selection and normalization protocol bytes; not a claim of absolute Kolmogorov complexity
enumeration: lexical nested list order direction, offset, multiplier, intercept; retain all ties
exact_candidate_screen: family p <= 0.01, exactly one best-scoring rule, and zero incorrect predictions across all N covered Greek letters; even if passed, only an exploratory candidate awaiting variant/human explanation checks and external confirmation
matrix: M[r,i,k] = literal match count between predicted unit i under rule r and actual Greek unit k
neighbour_policy: Neighbour v+1 follows original Hebrew stream order even for reverse positional traversal; one wrap from last to first is explicit; chapter/book boundaries are not optimized or hidden
normalization: existing normalized consonantal Hebrew with final forms folded; existing normalized Greek including explicit iota subscript expansion
null_model: uniform permutation of the 16 Greek units conditional on the observed units and predictions; preserves within-unit sequence and alphabet frequencies; NOT a universal human-authorship model
purpose: First finite family of literal cross-alphabet predictions; not an exhaustive language of short rules
right_coverage: N = 16 * floor(len(Greek)/16), all leading N letters; report the trailing 0..15 omitted letters without trying other boundaries
rule: For Greek position j in 0..N-1 set t=floor(j*len(Hebrew)/N); set u=t if direction=1, otherwise len(Hebrew)-1-t; set v=(u+offset) mod len(Hebrew); set q=(22*HebrewRank[v]+HebrewRank[(v+1) mod len(Hebrew)]) mod 24; predict Greek rank (a*q+b) mod 24
score: 16 * sum_i M[r,i,permutation(i)] - sum_i,k M[r,i,k]; integer centered on the uniform-unit-order expectation; no division or numeric tolerance needed
secondary_outputs: every rule and its observed score and match count; best raw-match rules and all score ties; no additional candidate selected by these descriptive outputs
selection_statistic: max score over ALL 3072 rules, recomputed for every randomized order
tail: (1 + count(reference maxima >= observed maximum))/(1 + number of reference draws), inclusive ties
target_selection: single ordered concatenation Gen Exod Lev Num Deut, and single ordered concatenation of all 27 SBLGNT books in existing catalog order; no book-pair selection or sliding starts
unit_policy: Greek and each predicted stream split into 16 equal consecutive units, only for the declared randomization; no text boundary is optimized
variant_scope: Modern editions only; relative global positions and lengths can be sensitive to variants; no claim that Qumran authenticates either complete stream
